tagline: 奥林巴斯数码相机，2004 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2004年推出的数码相机。配备Olympus 1:2.8-1:3.4/6.4-51.2mm (40-320mm) zoom lens with 10 elements in 7 groups。快门速度8 - 1/1000 sec.。TTL system autofocus with contrast detection system。

specs.镜头: Olympus 1:2.8-1:3.4/6.4-51.2mm (40-320mm) zoom lens with 10 elements in 7 groups
specs.传感器: 1/2.5" CCD solid state image pickup, 3,340,000 pixels
specs.对焦: TTL system autofocus with contrast detection system
specs.取景器: 0.5" color LCD with optical viewfinder, 114,000 pixels
specs.英文简介: The Olympus Camedia C-725 Ultra Zoom is a digital zoom camera made by Olympus in Japan.
